product.title: Less managing work.
product.text: Work is rarely just a list of tasks. It is ownership, decisions, files and conversations. Denalify connects them in one workspace so the team can see what is due, what is blocked and what comes next.

features.title: See the work clearly
features.text: Move from a Kanban board to a list or calendar without losing the story behind every task.

features.title: Keep context close
features.text: Documents, comments, files and a shared whiteboard live beside the project, not in another tab.

features.title: Make progress visible
features.text: Bring multiple projects together with a portfolio view, analytics and activity history.

features.title: Connect the tools you use
features.text: Link work to GitHub and receive updates through Slack or Discord. Automations and webhooks handle repeatable steps.

paths.title: The right view for
paths.text: Start with the tasks your team owns, then zoom out to the flow of a whole project. These are connected parts of the same workspace, with the same people, files and updates.

tasks.label: TEAM TASKS
tasks.title: Know who is doing what.
tasks.text: Create tasks with assignees, deadlines, priorities, checklists and dependencies. Keep comments and attachments on the task so a handoff has its context.

boards.label: KANBAN BOARDS
boards.title: See the work move.
boards.text: Arrange tasks in project columns, move them as work progresses and filter the board when you need to focus. Switch to a list or calendar without rebuilding the project.

workflow.title: One flow, from
workflow.text: Give ideas a path forward, make responsibilities visible and keep the whole team aligned along the way.

steps.title: Give every project its context.
steps.text: Plan visually, write the brief and connect the tasks that depend on one another.

steps.title: Keep momentum without the noise.
steps.text: Use boards, views and updates to know what is moving and what needs attention.

seo.description: Organize team tasks with assignees, deadlines, checklists, dependencies and comments. Keep work and project context together in Denalify.
seo.ogDescription: Track who owns each task, what comes next and the context behind the work.
seo.imageTitle: A task manager for work your team shares.
seo.imageDescription: Tasks, people, deadlines and conversations in one workspace.

hero.title: A task manager
hero.lede: Denalify helps a team turn plans into work that has an owner, a deadline and a next step. Tasks sit inside projects alongside the discussions and files that explain them. See your own assignments or the full board.
hero.alt: Denalify project board showing assigned tasks, due dates, priorities and checklist progress
hero.caption: ACTUAL DENALIFY BOARD / CLASSIC THEME

intro.title: Tasks stay useful
intro.text: A good task manager shows who is responsible, when work matters and where to find the decisions made along the way.

steps.title: Capture the work
steps.text: Create a task in the right project, add a clear description and break larger work into checklist items.

steps.title: Make ownership visible
steps.text: Assign people, set a due date and priority, and add labels so important work is easy to find.

steps.title: Follow through together
steps.text: Discuss details in comments, attach files and use activity history to understand what changed.

details.title: Keep context close
paragraphs: A task title is rarely enough for a handoff. Write the brief in the description, add smaller steps as a checklist and work through questions in comments. Attach a file when the work needs a reference.
Dependencies show what must finish first. Priorities, due dates and labels make a growing project easier to scan. Activity history records changes, while project chat handles broader conversation.
Open My Tasks to see assignments across projects. For a view of the whole project, open its

items.title: Planning a release
items.text: Keep design, development and review in one project. Assign each task, mark blockers and use checklists to make completion criteria clear.

items.title: Running ongoing team work
items.text: Give routine requests a place on the board. Comments and files keep their details, while My Tasks shows each person what to do next.

items.title: Working with a small team
items.text: Start with one board and a few columns. Add an owner, due date or dependency where it helps. Try the workflow in a free workspace.

items.question: Can I see my tasks across projects?
items.answer: Yes. My Tasks brings assigned work together without opening every project board.

items.question: Can a task depend on another task?
items.answer: Yes. Dependencies show what needs to finish first and when a task is blocked.

items.question: Can I keep the discussion with the task?
items.answer: Yes. Comments and attachments stay with the task. Project chat is available for broader discussion.

cta.title: Give the next task
cta.text: Create a free Denalify workspace, invite your team and start with the work already on your plate.

intro.title: A project view that
intro.text: Use columns to show where work stands today. Move a card when its status changes, then open the task for details.

steps.title: Shape the workflow
steps.text: Create columns that match how your team works. Start with To Do, In Progress and Done; add stages when needed.

steps.title: Move work forward
steps.text: Move cards as progress changes. See priorities, deadlines and checklist progress without opening each task.

steps.title: Focus the view
steps.text: Filter by assignee, status, priority, deadline or label when the board gets busy.

details.title: The task behind
paragraphs: Open a task to see its description, assignees, priority, due date and checklist. Keep comments and files where the team needs them.
The board is a shared view of the same project work. Switch to a list or calendar without losing tasks or their history.

details.related: My Tasks and team task management

items.title: Collect requests
items.text: Put new website requests in To Do, with a brief and an owner on each card.

items.title: Track progress
items.text: Move design and content into In Progress. Add a review column so approvals are visible.

items.title: Deliver together
items.text: Keep acceptance steps, files and due dates on tasks. Filter by assignee to focus without changing the shared board.

items.question: Can I use more than three columns?
items.answer: Yes. Create columns for the stages that make sense for your project.

items.question: Can I filter a busy board?
items.answer: Yes. Filter by assignee, priority, status, deadline or label.

items.question: Do I have to use a board for every review?
items.answer: No. The same project also has a list and calendar view.
